0022600129.text: The Pistons are 2-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East, and they are on the road against a Knicks team that is 0-2, 4th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and 11th in the East. Detroit is without Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 126-111 win in New York on February 19, 2026.
